reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, advertisements are everywhere in our daily life. Some people think this is good, but others think it is bad. In my opinion, advertising has both positive and negative effects.  
On the one hand, advertisements have some benefits. First, they help consumers choose products easily. In the past, people only bought items from local shops, but now TV ads and social media pop-ups show many new products, so people can make better choices. Second, advertising is good for the economy. Good ads make people want to buy more things, which helps companies sell more products. Because of this, companies need more workers, and governments get more tax money.  
On the other hand, advertising also has drawbacks. First, many ads make people waste money. When famous people promote a product, customers like it and buy things they do not really need. Second, too many advertisements make people feel annoyed. For example, when people watch movies or play games on the internet, pop-up ads appear all the time and stop their activities. People often cannot turn off these ads for 30 seconds.  
In conclusion, advertisements are helpful because they give information and support the economy, but they also cause bad spending habits and annoy people.
reviews.overall: Em trả lời đúng hướng hai mặt và chọn đúng hai tác hại được phép. Hai đoạn thân bài có mạch nguyên nhân–kết quả cơ bản, nhất là phần quảng cáo hỗ trợ lựa chọn và tạo việc làm. Tuy nhiên, bài mới có 203 từ, chưa đạt yêu cầu tối thiểu 250 từ; một số chuỗi Cô giao còn rút ngắn nên chưa đủ chi tiết. Em cần mở rộng đúng các ý đã cho, sửa cách diễn đạt ở ví dụ pop-up và nộp lại bản hoàn chỉnh.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
In my opinion, the growing prevalence of advertisements in everyday life brings both benefits and drawbacks.

On the one hand, advertising can benefit consumers and the wider economy. From consumers’ perspective, commercials provide a convenient buying experience. Unlike in the past, when people largely relied on local shops and brands, television advertisements, social-media pop-ups and street billboards now expose them to a wide range of goods. As a result, consumers can compare products and make wiser purchasing decisions. On a wider scale, advertisements with engaging content and appealing visual effects can stimulate customers’ demand and purchasing power. This increased consumption encourages companies to raise production, creating more employment opportunities and generating additional revenue for the state budget.

On the other hand, advertising also has drawbacks. First, persuasive advertisements can entice people into buying things they may not otherwise need. This tendency is reinforced when celebrities with strong social influence endorse products, making them seem more trustworthy and desirable. Consequently, even people who are not fans may develop impulsive and wasteful buying habits. Second, audiences can feel overwhelmed by the large number of advertisements. For example, when people watch films or play games online, pop-up advertisements can appear constantly and interrupt their activities. They may be unable to close them for up to thirty seconds, which severely disrupts their online experience.

In conclusion, advertisements help people make informed choices and support economic growth, but they can also encourage wasteful spending and cause annoyance. Therefore, this development has both positive and negative effects.

reviews.question:
The media should include more stories which report good news.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, the media reports many different kinds of news, including both good and bad news. Some people believe that there should be more stories about good news. I partly agree with this opinion because good news can have some benefits, but bad news is also necessary.

On the one hand, good news can help people have a more positive view of life. Today, people often read news about wars, accidents, crimes and natural disasters. Therefore, reading positive stories can make them feel more hopeful and optimistic. For example, Nick Vujicic was born without arms and legs, but he did not give up. He became a famous motivational speaker and travelled around the world to inspire other people. Stories like this can encourage people to face difficulties and continue trying.

On the other hand, I believe that bad news should not be ignored. If the media only reports positive stories, people may not know about serious problems in society. For instance, when people often read news about serious traffic accidents caused by drunk driving, they may become more careful when driving. They can also advise their friends and family not to drink alcohol before driving. In this way, bad news can help people understand real problems and avoid dangerous behaviour.

In conclusion, I partly agree that the media should report more good news because it can make people more positive and motivated. However, bad news is also important because it helps people understand and deal with problems in society.
reviews.overall: Em đã viết được phần tin tốt giúp người đọc lạc quan, nêu đúng ví dụ Nick Vujicic và giải thích tin xấu có thể ngăn hành vi lái xe khi say rượu. Tuy nhiên, dàn ý bài này yêu cầu không đồng ý; em lại chọn đồng ý một phần. Body 1 còn thiếu hẳn phần phản biện về thói quen xem tin gây sốc, lượng người đọc và doanh thu của cơ quan báo chí. Ví dụ ở Body 2 cũng thiếu chi tiết gia đình bốn người. Em viết lại theo đúng lập trường và chuỗi ý đã học, đồng thời bổ sung ít nhất hai từ để đạt 250 từ.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
The suggestion that news outlets should publish more positive stories has gained attention. I disagree with this proposal because it overlooks practical constraints and the value of reporting distressing events.

Admittedly, more frequent coverage of good news may offer some advantages, but increasing it substantially may be impractical. Positive stories can help people adopt a more optimistic view of the world and life. For example, Nick Vujicic was born without arms and legs, yet he faced many challenges without giving up and became a world-famous motivational speaker who travels to inspire others. However, the proposal fails to consider what audiences choose to read and watch. Many people are drawn to breaking or shocking stories, such as political scandals and natural disasters. If news agencies replace too many such reports with positive stories, they may struggle to attract viewers and readers. This could reduce their revenue and, in extreme cases, lead some agencies to bankruptcy.

Moreover, bad news can benefit the public by warning people about existing and emerging problems in society. For instance, a report on a tragic accident could describe how a family of four lost their lives because the father drove under the influence of alcohol. People repeatedly exposed to such reports may be more likely to avoid drunk driving and to dissuade friends or relatives from doing so. This example shows how reports of deaths caused by dangerous driving can help the public avoid similar harm.

In conclusion, although good news may encourage optimism, I oppose the proposal to publish more of it because doing so could harm news agencies and reduce the warnings people receive about real dangers.

reviews.question:
Some scientists think there are intelligent life forms on other planets and messages should be sent to contact them. Other scientists think it is a bad idea and would be dangerous.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay: It is true that the existence of intelligent life forms on other planets is a topic of debate. While some scientists believe that we should send messages to contact aliens, others think that this action is very dangerous. In my opinion, I completely agree with the second view.   On the one hand, there are some reasons why people want to contact life on other planets. Currently, the Earth is facing many severe problems that seem to be insoluble, such as global warming, rising sea levels, and animal extinction. These environmental issues could eventually lead to the demise of our own race in the future. Therefore, if we can contact alien civilizations that have successfully dealt with such problems, they might pass on their invaluable knowledge to us. This help could allow humanity to solve environmental crises and avoid our extinction. For these reasons, it is understandable why some scientists advocate the idea of sending messages to inhabitants on other planets.   On the other hand, I believe that contacting aliens is a bad idea because it involves huge risks. Firstly, our technology is still insufficiently developed for space exploration, which is clearly seen in our failed attempts to send manned missions to Mars. If a civilization is capable of traveling to Earth, their technology must far exceed ours. Consequently, they would have very little to gain by working and coexisting with humanity, except for using us as their test subjects or slaves. Secondly, humans could easily be invaded by these extraterrestrial beings. With their superior technology, we would be rendered helpless against their possible invasion.   In conclusion, although trying to communicate with aliens might give us useful knowledge to solve current problems, I strongly believe that it is too dangerous. Therefore, we should not attempt to contact them to protect our survival
reviews.overall: Em đã thảo luận cả hai quan điểm, chọn quan điểm thứ hai và triển khai gần đủ các chuỗi ý được giao trong 301 từ. Mở bài lại gọi sự tồn tại của sinh vật ngoài hành tinh là vấn đề tranh luận, trong khi đề tập trung vào việc có nên gửi thông điệp; em cần diễn đạt đúng trọng tâm ấy. Câu đầu Body 1 mới nói có lý do muốn liên hệ, chưa nêu luận điểm chung là việc liên hệ có thể có lợi. Em sửa hai câu này, bỏ khung nêu ý kiến bị lặp và soát lại cụm từ cùng dấu chấm cuối bài.

criteria.action: Viết lại mở bài để tranh luận về việc gửi thông điệp và mở Body 1 bằng luận điểm chung rằng việc liên hệ có thể đem lại lợi ích.

criteria.title: Giải thích ý và phản biện
evidence: they might pass on their invaluable knowledge to us. This help could allow humanity to solve environmental crises and avoid our extinction.
If a civilization is capable of traveling to Earth, their technology must far exceed ours. Consequently, they would have very little to gain by working and coexisting with humanity
criteria.comment: Em nối được vấn đề môi trường với khả năng nhận kiến thức, và nối chênh lệch công nghệ với nguy cơ bị lợi dụng; ý xâm lược là nhánh riêng và có kết quả con người bất lực.

criteria.title: Vận dụng từ vựng và cấu trúc đã học
evidence: In my opinion, I completely agree with the second view.
they might pass on their invaluable knowledge to us
we would be rendered helpless against their possible invasion
criteria.comment: Em đã dùng ngôn ngữ khả năng và câu bị động đúng chỗ. Câu nêu lập trường dùng cả “In my opinion” lẫn “I completely agree”, làm trùng chức năng và chưa diễn đạt lại nội dung quan điểm.
criteria.action: Dùng một khung nêu quan điểm và viết rõ ý: “I strongly believe that sending such messages would pose serious risks.”

criteria.title: Nối câu, nối đoạn và dùng từ thay thế
evidence: On the one hand
On the other hand
Firstly
Secondly
This help could allow humanity to solve environmental crises and avoid our extinction.
criteria.comment: Hai Body được phân biệt rõ; “Firstly” và “Secondly” đánh dấu đúng hai rủi ro riêng trong Body 2. “This help” chỉ kiến thức người ngoài hành tinh có thể truyền lại.

criteria.title: Viết chính xác và tự soát bài
evidence: humans could easily be invaded by these extraterrestrial beings
to protect our survival
criteria.comment: “Humans could be invaded” không tự nhiên vì điều bị xâm lược ở đây là Trái Đất/nhân loại; “protect our survival” cũng là kết hợp từ chưa tự nhiên. Bài còn thiếu dấu chấm cuối.
criteria.action: Viết “humanity could face an invasion” và “to safeguard humanity’s survival”; thêm dấu chấm kết bài.

studentQuotes: I completely agree with the second view.
outlineCoverage.comment: Em chọn quan điểm thứ hai.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: →  ĐỒNG Ý VỚI VIEW 2

studentQuotes: the existence of intelligent life forms on other planets is a topic of debate
In my opinion, I completely agree with the second view.
outlineCoverage.comment: Có nêu hai luồng ý và lập trường, nhưng câu đầu chuyển đối tượng tranh luận từ việc gửi thông điệp sang sự tồn tại của sinh vật ngoài hành tinh.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: Intro: [paraphrase] [câu mẫu: đồng ý với View 2]

studentQuotes: On the one hand, there are some reasons why people want to contact life on other planets.
outlineCoverage.comment: Đoạn bàn view 1, nhưng câu chủ đề chỉ nói có lý do muốn liên hệ; cần nêu luận điểm chung rằng liên hệ có thể đem lại lợi ích.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: Body 1: [THẢO LUẬN VIEW 1]

studentQuotes: This help could allow humanity to solve environmental crises and avoid our extinction.
outlineCoverage.comment: Nêu được lợi ích có thể thu được từ liên hệ.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: * việc liên hệ tìm kiếm vật thể sống ngoài trái đất có đem lại lợi ích

studentQuotes: Currently, the Earth is facing many severe problems that seem to be insoluble, such as global warming, rising sea levels, and animal extinction.
These environmental issues could eventually lead to the demise of our own race in the future.
outlineCoverage.comment: Có đủ ba vấn đề được giao và nguy cơ dẫn tới diệt vong.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → there are currently many problems - seem to be insoluble: global warming, rising sea levels and animal extinction → eventually lead to the demise of our own race

studentQuotes: if we can contact alien civilizations that have successfully dealt with such problems, they might pass on their invaluable knowledge to us.
This help could allow humanity to solve environmental crises and avoid our extinction.
outlineCoverage.comment: Giữ đúng điều kiện liên hệ nền văn minh đã giải quyết vấn đề, khả năng truyền kiến thức và kết quả tránh tuyệt chủng.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → contact alien civilizations that have successfully dealt with such problems = perhaps pass on their invaluable knowledge → help us avoid our extinction

studentQuotes: For these reasons, it is understandable why some scientists advocate the idea of sending messages to inhabitants on other planets.
outlineCoverage.comment: Câu cuối quay lại giải thích vì sao có nhà khoa học ủng hộ gửi thông điệp.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → [chỉ viết được 1 ý - mà cũng ko thể lấy ví dụ được → chốt vòng lại câu chủ đề để tránh thiếu từ] understandable why some scientists advocate the idea of sending messages to inhabitants in other planets

studentQuotes: On the other hand, I believe that contacting aliens is a bad idea because it involves huge risks.
outlineCoverage.comment: Câu chủ đề nêu luận điểm chung về nguy hiểm và vai trò đoạn.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: Body 2: [TUY NHIÊN VIỆC NÀY QUÁ NGUY HIỂM]

studentQuotes: Firstly, our technology is still insufficiently developed for space exploration
outlineCoverage.comment: Mở nhánh rủi ro thứ nhất bằng sự hạn chế công nghệ.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: * công nghệ chưa đủ phát triển - thất bại nhiều

studentQuotes: which is clearly seen in our failed attempts to send manned missions to Mars.
outlineCoverage.comment: Em dùng ví dụ về nhiệm vụ có người lái tới sao Hỏa như dàn ý được giao.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → our technology - still insufficiently developed for space exploration - seen in our failed attempts to send manned missions to Mars

studentQuotes: If a civilization is capable of traveling to Earth, their technology must far exceed ours.
Consequently, they would have very little to gain by working and coexisting with humanity, except for using us as their test subjects or slaves.
outlineCoverage.comment: Giữ đủ chênh lệch công nghệ và nguy cơ bị biến thành đối tượng thí nghiệm hoặc nô lệ.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → a civilization - capable of traveling to Earth = their technology - far exceed ours → they have little to gain by working and coexisting with humanity - except for us being their test subjects or slaves

studentQuotes: Secondly, humans could easily be invaded by these extraterrestrial beings.
outlineCoverage.comment: Có nhánh rủi ro xâm lược riêng; cách diễn đạt cần sửa cho tự nhiên.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: * có thể bị xâm lược

studentQuotes: With their superior technology, we would be rendered helpless against their possible invasion.
outlineCoverage.comment: Nối công nghệ vượt trội với việc con người bất lực trước khả năng xâm lược.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: → their superior technology - we - be rendered helpless against their possible invasion

studentQuotes: I strongly believe that it is too dangerous. Therefore, we should not attempt to contact them
outlineCoverage.comment: Kết bài khẳng định lại lập trường không nên liên hệ.
outlineCoverage.requiredText: Conclu: [chốt lại quan điểm đã nêu ở Intro]

appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: This help could allow humanity to solve environmental crises and avoid our extinction.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: This knowledge could allow humanity to solve environmental crises and avoid our extinction.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Giữ chuỗi kiến thức có thể được truyền lại dẫn đến giải quyết vấn đề và tránh tuyệt chủng; đổi “This help” thành danh từ chỉ rõ ý trước.

appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: they might pass on their invaluable knowledge to us
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: they might pass on their invaluable knowledge to us
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Giữ “might” để diễn đạt khả năng, đồng thời giữ “could allow” và câu bị động “we would be rendered helpless” đúng quan hệ nghĩa.

appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: For these reasons, it is understandable why some scientists advocate the idea of sending messages to inhabitants on other planets.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: For these reasons, it is understandable why some scientists advocate the idea of sending messages to inhabitants on other planets.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Giữ đoạn một ý có chuỗi giải thích và câu chốt quay lại quan điểm thứ nhất; không thêm ví dụ hay lý do ngoài dàn ý.

appliedKnowledge.originalEvidence: On the one hand, there are some reasons why people want to contact life on other planets.
appliedKnowledge.revisionEvidence: On the one hand, contacting life on other planets could bring benefits.
appliedKnowledge.explanation: Sửa câu chủ đề Body 1 để nêu luận điểm chung về lợi ích rồi mới triển khai lý do và kết quả theo đúng bài được giao.
